constants.name: text_end
constants.comment: The byte that ends TITLE's text

subroutines.name: title_start
subroutines.title: TITLE: draw the title page and wait for a key
subroutines.description: Entered by */TITLE from the BASIC program DUNJUNZ. Select MODE 5 with colour 2 blue, fill the screen with stripe_pattern, copy title_picture into character rows 1-8, print the credits, title and keys, open an empty black window at the bottom, hide the cursor, flush the keyboard buffer and wait up to 7.67 seconds for a key, then return to BASIC.

banners.name: stripe_pattern
banners.title: Background stripe pattern
banners.description: One MODE 5 character cell, copied over the whole screen: even pixel rows black (&00), odd rows four pixels of colour 2 (&F0), which mode_vdu makes blue.

banners.name: mode_vdu
banners.title: VDU codes: MODE 5, colour 2 blue
banners.description: Eight bytes sent by title_start before anything is drawn: VDU 22,5 (MODE 5) and VDU 19,2,4,0,0,0 (logical colour 2 shows as blue).

banners.name: page_text
banners.title: VDU codes: credits, title and keys
banners.description: Printed by title_start up to the &FF terminator. The credits go at fixed text positions on the striped background; the title is printed in a text window cleared to black at columns 6-13, rows 10-12; the keys in a window cleared to white at columns 1-18, rows 18-24, in black text, as four lines of 18 characters.

banners.name: blank_line_text
banners.title: Text: a line of spaces
banners.description: Eighteen spaces and the &FF terminator, the width of the keys window. title_start prints them after the keys on any machine but an Electron; they fall on the window's next line, which is already white.

banners.name: black_window_vdu
banners.title: VDU codes: an empty black window
banners.description: Printed last: a text window at columns 2-17, rows 26-28, cleared to black with white text. TITLE prints nothing in it, and DUNK, which runs next, starts with MODE 7.

banners.name: tape_command
banners.title: Unused command strings
banners.description: Two CR-terminated OSCLI commands, *TAPE and */, that nothing in TITLE refers to.

banners.title: Unused
banners.description: Zeros up to the picture, which starts on a page boundary.

banners.name: title_picture
banners.title: The title picture
banners.description: Eight MODE 5 character rows (&A00 bytes, &140 a row, eight bytes a cell, top pixel row first), copied by title_start to character rows 1-8. A blue frame holds a white panel at the left, the name BUG BYTE in large white letters and a red and blue face at the right.

memory_map.name: mode5_screen
memory_map.description: The start of MODE 5's screen memory (&5800-&7FFF)

memory_map.name: title_picture_screen
memory_map.description: Character row 1 of the MODE 5 screen, where the logo picture is copied (&5940-&633F)
